name: aem-eds-inter-toranja
description: Toranja EDS: 73 componentes oficiais do Toranja 2.0.1, adaptador React e modelos XWalk

scripts.build: npm run build:ds-models && npm run build:json && npm run build:content && npm run build:reference && npm run build:runtime

scripts.build:runtime: node tools/check-runtime-contract.mjs && vite build && node tools/scope-runtime.mjs && node tools/build-delivery.mjs && node tools/minify-delivery.mjs && node tools/clean-page-build.mjs && vite build --config vite.page.config.mjs && node tools/build-preloads.mjs && node tools/write-version.mjs
